intro: Haiti has had no elected president or parliament since 2021 and is led by a transitional government.

chapters.title: Who rules
text: A transitional council and prime minister govern while elections are planned. Armed gangs control much of Port-au-Prince, and over a million people have been forced from their homes.

chapters.title: International help
text: A UN-approved security force led by Kenya arrived in 2024 to help the police.
